evaluation.search: analytic winner-score crossing event sweep over stable intervals
evaluation.complexity: O(E log E) per cell; no grid, linear/binary search, or Cartesian cell search
evaluation.objective: Lexicographically maximize aggregate winner-in-Top1 through winner-in-Top5 hits
evaluation.decision: ON only when a positive stable interval improves over weight 0; no-support and unknown cells default ON
